subjects.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcoll:ftColl_80078C70

evidence.why: Complete function establishes the local control flow and data dependencies.

subjects.behavior: Scans fighter attack capsules against the supplied defender under a global guard, participant filters and hit eligibility. For list-order-eligible grounded pairs, checks reciprocal attack clashes first. Otherwise checks shield and then ordered hurt capsules. Inert contacts write attacker bookkeeping; non-inert overlaps dispatch response helpers and optional audio.

subjects.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcoll:ftColl_8007925C

evidence.why: Complete function establishes the local control flow and data dependencies.

subjects.behavior: Scans four hitboxes of each eligible item against one fighter. Builds fighter attack eligibility flags, then applies per-item-hitbox guards and ordered reflection, absorption, clash/inert attack contact, shield and hurt handling. Successful earlier branches continue to the next item hitbox. It does not scan item hurt capsules.

subjects.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcoll:ftColl_80079AB0

evidence.why: Complete function establishes the local control flow and data dependencies.
Damage-count helper and shared formula define branch inputs and arithmetic order.

subjects.behavior: Returns the common capped knockback formula with explicit arg3, attack, defense and weight arguments. Nonzero hit.x28 substitutes fixed terms; otherwise accumulated or override damage plus temporary damage and unk_count contribute. It performs no direct state writes.

subjects.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcoll:ftColl_80079C70

evidence.why: Complete function establishes the local control flow and data dependencies.

subjects.behavior: Returns the same capped formula using victim co_attrs.weight, victim Player_GetDefenseRatio, attacker Player_GetAttackRatio and gm_8016B248. The signed unk_count argument is converted to u32 before float in the ordinary branch. It performs no direct state writes.

subjects.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcoll:ftColl_80079EA8

evidence.why: Complete function establishes the local control flow and data dependencies.
Damage-count helper and shared formula define branch inputs and arithmetic order.

subjects.behavior: Returns the common capped formula using victim weight and unit attack, defense and arg3 multipliers. Retains the same x28 fixed branch and ordinary damage branch. It performs no direct state writes.

subjects.subject: main/melee/ft/ftcoll:ftColl_8007A06C

evidence.why: Complete function establishes the local control flow and data dependencies.

subjects.behavior: Reduces a nonempty log to the earliest strict maximum-knockback entry, optionally spawning effects for category 1/2 candidates before selection. Writes a local DmgResult, dispatches source-dependent bookkeeping and sets electric vibration multiplier. Zero count returns before reading objects or output storage.
